quests.title: Sealed Site of Sacrifice

dialogue.sit: The scene materializes before you like some nostalgic memory.

Operations stream along countless convolutions, flowing spectrum paths that shift across layered platforms.
The accumulated Phlogiston coalesces under immense pressure into a floating, controllable ball of heat.
"We've done it!" Your brethren cheer all around you.
Yet the one who masterminded this feat, in no way inferior to star-forging, stands outside the experimental site, as though wholly unrelated to this momentous deed.

dialogue.t: Congratulations are in order. Creating something equivalent to a celestial body in miniature... An "Astral Assemblage," is it? Truly, a grand achievement, comparable with lunar reconstruction.
"That one" would surely have tucked their wings in and nodded congratulations to you — were they still with us.
"...If you had been willing to help, it might have been completed long ago."
I have no interest in it.
"...But you should help me, Kukulkan. We have driven the All-Plunderer's herald into the deepest of mountain valleys, yet once its master awakens..."
"It will surely bring another catastrophe upon our people."
Ah, how very noble of you, creating this thing to protect your pitiable brethren...
"This is only the beginning, and my days are numbered. I must forge a new path for the Dragonborn before the pitch-black shadow smothers us all."
Or, perhaps, you should let them find their own way... Forgive my forthrightness, but the path you plan to create may be too narrow for our kind.
"The narrow way must be walked. When your time runs short... When waiting becomes a luxury."
"Enough waiting, I say. A time will come, Kukulkan, when your days go down like the sun behind the hills, and you will understand. Then, you shall make the same decision as I have..."
...My king, my elder brother, O lord who gave me life on the day you yourself were born... On this alone I cannot concede to you.
Huh. That... Did we just see something that happened when this fireball was made?
Yeah, Paimon saw it super clearly this time as well... The ones surrounding this cake platform had to be the dragons who used to live here...
But who were the two people who were speaking, then? Weird...
Anyway, the seal on the Astral Assemblage here should be broken now, right?

quests.description: Find and stabilize the Astral Assemblage(s) to activate the Celestial Axis at the center of the Sacred City…
